description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per payload - the payment buys one signed validity-window evaluation of the payload you submit at the evaluation instant you state: remaining seconds and the verdict against the published TIGHT thresholds.

evaluation_at_unix.description: The evaluation instant, unix seconds. The window is evaluated at this instant, never at a hidden clock.

payload.description: The one signed-payload descriptor whose validity window is evaluated: rail plus its validity fields (e.g. valid_before for EVM).

name: validity_check_validity
